title: Update: Finished Chapter One of My Shining Force 1 AI Remake - Fully Playable on itch.io! (Skill Trees, New Battle System & More)
author: Exped1ter001
selftext:
**Shining Force Reimagined: Chapter One** ***(AI-Assisted (obviously) Tactical RPG Remake)***

**Hello everyone,**  
**it took me 3 months now but I have a complete, from-the-ground-up reimagining of the 1992 Sega Genesis classic Shining Force: The Legacy of Great Intention, A turn-based tactical RPG . I rebuilt this using AI assets but I built editors to easily replace that with real assets if an artist ever joined in.**

**here is a link to the Itch IO game if you would like to try .**

**\*\*\* there might be a few bugs as this is a brand new build i jsut uploaded last night\*\*\***

[Shining Force 1 - Fan Remake by Exped1ter](https://exped1ter.itch.io/sf1-test?secret=kUC8NoXaXTDQkAnDRP3LlRNJkw)

**let me know what you think and please know that this is only 3 months of work obviously its not polished or perfect.**

**Core Gameplay**

**The game splits into two main parts:**

* **Town Exploration - Walk around towns, talk to NPCs, recruit new party members (over 10 unique characters in this chapter one build), shop for weapons and items, and advance the story.**

https://preview.redd.it/2yxlwcw9psug1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=208e83ebb7f4f2ed3bb04ed15c6bb1165d024eaf



* **Tactical Battles - Large grid-based battlefields where you control up to 12 party members at a time. Combat is fully turn-based:**
   * **Units move a set number of squares based on their Move stat.**
   * **You can attack, cast spells, use items, and how use abilities and advance your skill tree.**

https://preview.redd.it/la8z18xcpsug1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=6e54b6deb08052527fb174d9cb147afb7ba12e31



https://preview.redd.it/9esnrnefpsug1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=a4089a9b3bb045efa7465d63bfae4764b70fb4f3



* **Positioning, terrain, range, and character classes (knights, mages, archers, centaurs, etc.) are crucial.**

**It’s a perfect mix of story, character recruitment, and deep tactical strategy.**

**What Makes This Remake Different**

**This isn’t a simple port, remaster, or ROM hack, it’s a full passion-project overhaul built from scratch over nearly 3 months:**

* **All new Visuals - Completely new art style and assets currently AI with as much touchup as I could do.**

https://preview.redd.it/t4gwo4eipsug1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=ac8c4b273795f753fd1055b846da7c8ca0d720bb



* **Brand New Soundtrack - Fully redone music that captures the epic feel of the classic while sounding modern and immersive.**
* **New Progression Systems - Skill trees and unique abilities for every character, letting you build and specialize your party like never before.**

https://preview.redd.it/7g474vfkpsug1.png?width=1058&format=png&auto=webp&s=065143f4698123e85ffa371b81d5e5d964a39824



* **Expanded World & Story(WIP) - New NPCs , new dialogue, and new Towns.**
* **Modern Quality-of-Life Upgrades - Completely new menu system, difficulty selection new Enemy AI , new priest and shop menus .**

https://preview.redd.it/x6yy7m8mpsug1.png?width=1058&format=png&auto=webp&s=44ce4fc05696016834c2c7bb7925b80107e3305f



* **Faithful Core Gameplay - Still the classic Shining Force experience : explore towns, recruit heroes, prepare your party, then fight on grid-based battlefields where positioning, terrain, and turn order (based on agility) matter.** 

**Current Status Chapter One:**

* **Fully complete and playable (possible bugs as this is a brand new build)**
* **90% done with bug fixing and AI art cleanup**  
* **Full battle animations and cinematic cutscenes are not done yet.** 

**This is a passion project of  my favorite video game as a child. If you grew up with Shining Force you may really enjoy a playthrough of this.** 

**More chapters are planned - this is just the beginning of the reborn Shining Force saga!**

replies.author: Exped1ter001
replies.body:
lol it’s insane , literally the only reason I opened up godot was to make the music loop( couldn’t do it in code quickly) and when you open it in imports all assets so I open it to do that. Other the that the game is 100% coded and json ( data) driven. Godot is cool in that you can use it as a renderer and not actually use it to make the game.  

I have NO IDEA how pros make game’s but all I did was build it from the ground up with being code and data driven. Then I made my own editors. I’ll post them.

comments.body: Amazing work! Shining Force was one of my childhood favourites, and is still one of my all time favourite games! I was even playing an Alternate Shining Force a few days ago. I might actually give it a try once you've added more chapters!

replies.author: Exped1ter001
replies.body: Thanks ! I absolutely loved this game as a kid. I was hoping to get some feedback on the work I did for chapter one to see if I should go forward and build it out more.  If you have some free time someday please give it a try. I added a new secret character , a new town , and a boss fight in the new town. I would appreciate feedback as I have never built a game in my life.

replies.author: iEpsilonAlpha
replies.body:
I'm personally a fan of the smaller character assets, similar to the original. What you're building is a solid project. It gives me inspiration to create a 2D remaster of the original SF2, lol.

I tried out until the first battle. Here's my experience:

\* Definitely continue making more chapters. I love the classic BGMs in higher quality.

\* I like that it's in HTML. No downloads, no setups needed. It just works!

\* You may want to add authentication to save progress in some database online.

\* The water sprites would look nice if animated in the town.

\* When showing the gains from level up, I think it would be nice to list it all together, instead of seprate menus for +4HP, +2MP, etc

\* The revive mechanic would be nice if we limit it to one, takes a single turn, and returns to something like 30% HP maybe. I revived a unit and it got raised with 1 HP, and it took two turns. I feel like each turn is valuable in SF, and it doesn't have to mirror reality. It also locks the reviver in place while the process is active.

Some bugs I noticed:

\* The party joining BGM overlaps with the map BGM. 

\* Something feels off to me about the walking animation.

\* No full attack animation, which you mentioned.

\* When characters overlap while walking over others during a battle, some sprites layer over, and some layer under.

replies.author: Exped1ter001
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for the feedback. I stated animating some water in the new town and the waterfall in Alterone. I have started looking into how to animate static water sprites in godot I have a prototype animated water version now but it’s not uploaded. This is the first game I have ever made so I’m not sure the best way to animate the static images. 

If you revive with a healer it’s faster I’ll make sure if you revive with a healer it’s about 1 turn and they come back with more hp. Later, there are healers that have abilities that do instant revives as well (khris) 

I will fix the sprites overlapping.As for the walking, it’s off for sure. It’s a bit like gliding. I wanted to make it quick so you can move around at a decent speed. To make it feel better I need to match the animation with the speed. 

Saving works in browser right now but it might be better to have a robust save system for when I make more chapters.  

Thanks a lot for the feedback back I will try to polish it up a bit more.
